1	# SmolVLM: Redefining Small and Efficient Multimodal Models
     2	
     3	## Source
     4	https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.05299
     5	
     6	## Overview
     7	
     8	SmolVLM is a family of compact vision-language models (VLMs) from Hugging Face and Stanford University, designed for resource-efficient inference on mobile and edge devices. The series includes three model sizes — 256M, 500M, and 2.2B parameters — that achieve competitive performance against much larger models while using dramatically less GPU memory. The smallest model, SmolVLM-256M, runs inference with less than 1GB GPU RAM and outperforms the 300× larger Idefics-80B model. All weights, datasets, code, and a mobile app (HuggingSnap) are fully open-sourced.
     9	
    10	## Architecture Design
    11	
    12	![SmolVLM Architecture](./assets/figure_3.jpg)
    13	
    14	SmolVLM uses a pipeline where images are split into sub-images, encoded by a SigLIP vision encoder, compressed via pixel shuffle (space-to-depth), projected through a linear layer into the SmolLM2 language model's input space, and concatenated with text token embeddings. For video, frames are sampled and processed similarly.
    15	
    16	Three critical architectural findings drive the design:
    17	
    18	**Finding 1 — Balanced Encoder-LM Compute:** Compact VLMs benefit from smaller vision encoders. A 93M SigLIP-B/16 paired with a 135M LM outperforms a 428M SigLIP-SO400M with the same LM. Only at 1.7B LM scale does the larger encoder justify its 10% parameter overhead.
    19	
    20	**Finding 2 — Extended Context Length:** Performance improves significantly when extending context from 2K to 16K tokens. This was achieved by increasing the RoPE base from 10K to 273K and fine-tuning on mixed long/short-context data. The 2.2B model uses 16K context; smaller variants use 8K.
    21	
    22	**Finding 3 — Aggressive Token Compression:** Pixel shuffle rearranges spatial features into channels, reducing visual tokens by r². While larger models use r=2, small VLMs benefit from r=4 (16× token reduction), easing attention overhead and improving long-context modeling.
    23	
    24	![Pixel Shuffle Diagram](./assets/figure_6.jpg)
    25	
    26	## Benchmark Performance
    27	
    28	SmolVLM was evaluated across 13 benchmarks spanning single-image understanding, multi-task reasoning, and video comprehension. The "Efficient OS" column shows the best open-source model under similar constraints.
    29	
    30	| Capability | Benchmark | SmolVLM 256M | SmolVLM 500M | SmolVLM 2.2B | Best Efficient OS |
    31	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
    32	| Single-Image | OCRBench | 52.6% | 61.0% | 72.9% | 54.7% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    33	| Single-Image | AI2D | 46.4% | 59.2% | 70.0% | 71.0% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    34	| Single-Image | ChartQA | 55.6% | 62.8% | 68.7% | 48.0% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    35	| Single-Image | TextVQA | 50.2% | 60.2% | 73.0% | 61.5% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    36	| Single-Image | DocVQA | 58.3% | 70.5% | 80.0% | 77.7% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    37	| Single-Image | ScienceQA | 73.8% | 80.0% | 89.6% | 87.5% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    38	| Multi-task | MMMU | 29.0% | 33.7% | 42.0% | 33.9% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    39	| Multi-task | MathVista | 35.9% | 40.1% | 51.5% | 37.6% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    40	| Multi-task | MMStar | 34.6% | 38.3% | 46.0% | 43.1% (Molmo-A1B-7B) |
    41	| Video | Video-MME | 33.7% | 42.2% | 52.1% | 45.0% (InternVL2-2B) |
    42	| Video | MLVU | 40.6% | 47.3% | 55.2% | 48.2% (InternVL2-2B) |
    43	| **Average** | **All Benchmarks** | **44.0%** | **51.0%** | **59.8%** | — |
    44	
    45	**RAM Usage:** SmolVLM-256M uses 0.8 GB (batch=1), SmolVLM-500M uses 1.2 GB, and SmolVLM-2.2B uses 4.9 GB. For comparison, Molmo-A1B-7B requires 27.7 GB.
    46	
    47	## On-Device Deployment
    48	
    49	![Mobile App and Throughput](./assets/figure_2.jpg)
    50	
    51	SmolVLM runs on-device via the HuggingSnap iOS app, processing photos and videos entirely locally with no cloud dependency. Throughput benchmarks across Apple Silicon devices show:
    52	
    53	- SmolVLM-256M achieves up to ~80 tokens/second on Pro M1 Max 64GB
    54	- At batch size 64, the 256M model reaches nearly 1000 tokens/second on high-end devices
    55	- Even on a MacBook Air M3 16GB, the 256M model produces ~55 tokens/second
    56	- Throughput scales roughly linearly with batch size for the smallest model
    57	
    58	## Key Findings
    59	
    60	- **Sub-1GB inference is achievable:** SmolVLM-256M uses only 0.8 GB GPU RAM at batch size 1, enabling deployment on smartphones and low-power edge devices.
    61	- **SmolVLM-256M surpasses the 300× larger Idefics-80B** despite an 18-month development gap, demonstrating that architectural efficiency matters more than raw scale.
    62	- **Balanced encoder-LM sizing, aggressive pixel shuffle (r=4), and extended context (up to 16K tokens)** are the three most impactful design choices for compact VLMs.
    63	- **SmolVLM-2.2B rivals state-of-the-art models** that consume twice the GPU memory, achieving 59.8% average across 13 benchmarks.
    64	- **All models, data, code, and a mobile app are fully open-sourced** to promote reproducibility and on-device AI research.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build the 9-slide SmolVLM technical presentation."""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RgbColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.oxml.ns import nsmap
from pptx.oxml import parse_xml
import os

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Constants
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SLIDE_WIDTH = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_HEIGHT = Inches(7.5)

# Palette
DARK_BG = RgbColor(0x11, 0x18, 0x27)       # ~slate-900
DARKER_BG = RgbColor(0x0B, 0x0F, 0x19)     # deeper background
ACCENT = RgbColor(0x38, 0xBD, 0xF8)        # cyan-400
ACCENT2 = RgbColor(0x34, 0xD3, 0x99)       # emerald-400
TEXT_PRIMARY = RgbColor(0xF1, 0xF5, 0xF9)  # slate-100
TEXT_SECONDARY = RgbColor(0x94, 0xA3, 0xB8) # slate-400
WHITE = RgbColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)

ASSETS_DIR = "/app/benchmark/assets"
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    background = slide.background
    fill = background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=18,
                bold=False, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name="Calibri"):
    tf = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height).text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = align
    return tf


def add_bullet_list(slide, left, top, width, height, items,
                    font_size=16, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, line_spacing=1.3,
                    bullet_color=ACCENT):
    tf = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height).text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = "•  " + item
        p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.name = "Calibri"
        p.space_after = Pt(10)
        p.line_spacing = line_spacing
    return tf


def add_shape_bar(slide, left, top, width, height, color):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def add_line(slide, left, top, width, color, thickness=Pt(1)):
    line = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, thickness)
    line.fill.solid()
    line.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    line.line.fill.background()
    return line

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Slide builders
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def build_title_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # blank
    set_slide_bg(slide, DARK_BG)

    # Accent top bar
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_WIDTH, Inches(0.08), ACCENT)

    # Title
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.2), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.4),
                "SmolVLM: Redefining Small and Efficient Multimodal Models",
                font_size=40, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # Subtitle
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(3.6), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.7),
                "Hugging Face  ·  Stanford University",
                font_size=22, bold=False, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # One-liner
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.5), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.0),
                "A family of compact vision-language models that achieve competitive performance with dramatically lower memory footprints through strategic architectural optimizations.",
                font_size=18, bold=False, color=TEXT_PRIMARY, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT)

    # Key stat badge
    badge = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                                   Inches(0.8), Inches(5.7), Inches(4.2), Inches(0.7))
    badge.fill.solid()
    badge.fill.fore_color.rgb = RgbColor(0x1E, 0x29, 0x3B)
    badge.line.color.rgb = ACCENT
    badge.line.width = Pt(1.5)
    tf = badge.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "Sub-1GB inference  ·  Outperforms 300× larger Idefics-80B"
    p.font.size = Pt(14)
    p.font.color.rgb = ACCENT
    p.font.bold = True
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    # Try to add architecture image on right
    img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_3.jpg")
    if os.path.exists(img_path):
        slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(8.5), Inches(2.0), width=Inches(4.0))


def build_problem_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_WIDTH, Inches(0.06), ACCENT)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.7), Inches(0.5), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "Large VLMs Are Powerful but Impractical for Edge Deployment",
                font_size=32, bold=True, color=WHITE)

    bullets = [
        "State-of-the-art VLMs (e.g., Idefics-80B, Molmo-A1B-7B) require 10–80 GB of GPU RAM, making mobile and edge deployment infeasible.",
        "Memory bottlenecks dominate inference latency and power consumption on resource-constrained devices.",
        "Existing ‘efficient’ open-source models still exceed 20 GB RAM, leaving a gap for truly compact multimodal inference.",
        "SmolVLM closes this gap: the 256M model runs in <1 GB RAM while outperforming models 300× its size."
    ]
    add_bullet_list(slide, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.6), Inches(7.5), Inches(5.0), bullets, font_size=17)

    # Simple comparison boxes
    box_w = Inches(3.8)
    box_h = Inches(1.6)
    box_top = Inches(1.8)
    box_left = Inches(8.5)

    # Molmo box
    box1 = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, box_left, box_top, box_w, box_h)
    box1.fill.solid(); box1.fill.fore_color.rgb = RgbColor(0x1E, 0x29, 0x3B)
    box1.line.color.rgb = TEXT_SECONDARY; box1.line.width = Pt(1)
    tf1 = box1.text_frame; tf1.word_wrap = True
    p1 = tf1.paragraphs[0]; p1.text = "Molmo-A1B-7B"; p1.font.size = Pt(16); p1.font.bold = True; p1.font.color.rgb = WHITE; p1.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    p1b = tf1.add_paragraph(); p1b.text = "27.7 GB RAM"; p1b.font.size = Pt(22); p1b.font.bold = True; p1b.font.color.rgb = RgbColor(0xFB, 0x71, 0x85); p1b.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    p1c = tf1.add_paragraph(); p1c.text = "Best Efficient OS baseline"; p1c.font.size = Pt(12); p1c.font.color.rgb = TEXT_SECONDARY; p1c.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    # SmolVLM box
    box2 = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, box_left, box_top + Inches(2.0), box_w, box_h)
    box2.fill.solid(); box2.fill.fore_color.rgb = RgbColor(0x1E, 0x29, 0x3B)
    box2.line.color.rgb = ACCENT2; box2.line.width = Pt(2)
    tf2 = box2.text_frame; tf2.word_wrap = True
    p2 = tf2.paragraphs[0]; p2.text = "SmolVLM-256M"; p2.font.size = Pt(16); p2.font.bold = True; p2.font.color.rgb = WHITE; p2.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    p2b = tf2.add_paragraph(); p2b.text = "0.8 GB RAM"; p2b.font.size = Pt(22); p2b.font.bold = True; p2b.font.color.rgb = ACCENT2; p2b.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    p2c = tf2.add_paragraph(); p2c.text = "Outperforms Idefics-80B (80B params)"; p2c.font.size = Pt(12); p2c.font.color.rgb = TEXT_SECONDARY; p2c.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER


def build_architecture_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_WIDTH, Inches(0.06), ACCENT)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.7), Inches(0.45), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "SmolVLM Architecture: Image Splitting, Pixel Shuffle, and SmolLM2 Backbone",
                font_size=30, bold=True, color=WHITE)

    # Add architecture image
    img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_3.jpg")
    if os.path.exists(img_path):
        slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.4), width=Inches(11.9))

    # Pipeline steps below image
    steps = [
        ("1. Image Splitting", "Input images are tiled into sub-images for local processing."),
        ("2. SigLIP Vision Encoder", "Sub-images encoded by a lightweight SigLIP model (93M params for smallest variant)."),
        ("3. Pixel Shuffle (r=4)", "Spatial features rearranged into channels → 16× token reduction."),
        ("4. Linear Projection", "Compressed visual tokens projected into SmolLM2 language model input space."),
        ("5. SmolLM2 Backbone", "Text and visual embeddings concatenated; decoder generates multimodal outputs."),
    ]

    y = Inches(5.5)
    for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(steps):
        x = Inches(0.7 + i * 2.45)
        # small accent bar
        add_shape_bar(slide, x, y, Inches(0.15), Inches(0.5), ACCENT if i < 3 else ACCENT2)
        add_textbox(slide, x + Inches(0.25), y, Inches(2.1), Inches(0.25), title, font_size=12, bold=True, color=WHITE)
        add_textbox(slide, x + Inches(0.25), y + Inches(0.25), Inches(2.1), Inches(0.6), desc, font_size=10, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)


def build_compute_allocation_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_WIDTH, Inches(0.06), ACCENT)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.7), Inches(0.45), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "Smaller Vision Encoders Outperform Larger Ones in Compact VLMs",
                font_size=30, bold=True, color=WHITE)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.1), Inches(12), Inches(0.5),
                "Finding 1 — Balanced Encoder-LM Compute: compact VLMs benefit from smaller vision encoders.",
                font_size=16, bold=False, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

    # Bar chart area
    chart_left = Inches(1.0)
    chart_top = Inches(1.9)
    chart_width = Inches(8.0)
    chart_height = Inches(4.2)

    # Y-axis labels
    add_textbox(slide, chart_left - Inches(0.6), chart_top, Inches(0.5), Inches(0.3), "Better", font_size=11, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)
    add_textbox(slide, chart_left - Inches(0.6), chart_top + chart_height - Inches(0.3), Inches(0.5), Inches(0.3), "Worse", font_size=11, color=TEXT_SECONDARY, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)

    # Baseline line
    add_line(slide, chart_left, chart_top + chart_height * 0.5, chart_width, TEXT_SECONDARY, Pt(1))
    add_textbox(slide, chart_left + chart_width + Inches(0.1), chart_top + chart_height * 0.5 - Inches(0.15), Inches(1.5), Inches(0.3),
                "Baseline", font_size=11, color=TEXT_SECONDARY)

    # Bar 1: 93M SigLIP-B/16 + 135M LM  (better)
    bar1_w = Inches(1.6)
    bar1_h = Inches(1.6)
    bar1 = add_shape_bar(slide, chart_left + Inches(1.0), chart_top + chart_height * 0.5 - bar1_h, bar1_w, bar1_h, ACCENT)
    add_textbox(slide, chart_left + Inches(1.0), chart_top + chart_height * 0.5 - bar1_h - Inches(0.35), bar1_w, Inches(0.3),
                "93M SigLIP-B/16\n+ 135M LM", font_size=13, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_textbox(slide, chart_left + Inches(1.0), chart_top + chart_height * 0.5 + Inches(0.1), bar1_w, Inches(0.3),
                "↑ Outperforms", font_size=12, bold=True, color=ACCENT, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    # Bar 2: 428M SigLIP-SO400M + 135M LM (worse)
    bar2_w = Inches(1.6)
    bar2_h = Inches(1.0)
    bar2 = add_shape_bar(slide, chart_left + Inches(3.8), chart_top + chart_height * 0.5, bar2_w, bar2_h, RgbColor(0xFB, 0x71, 0x85))
    add_textbox(slide, chart_left + Inches(3.8), chart_top + chart_height * 0.5 + bar2_h + Inches(0.05), bar2_w, Inches(0.4),
                "428M SigLIP-SO400M\n+ 135M LM", font_size=13, bold=True, color=WHITE, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_textbox(slide, chart_left + Inches(3.8), chart_top + chart_height * 0.5 - Inches(0.35), bar2_w, Inches(0.3),
                "↓ Underperforms", font_size=12, bold=True, color=RgbColor(0xFB, 0x71, 0x85), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

    # Annotation
    add_textbox(slide, chart_left + Inches(6.2), chart_top + Inches(0.8), Inches(3.5), Inches(2.0),
                "Only at 1.7B LM scale does the larger encoder justify its 10% parameter overhead.\n\n"
                "Implication: allocate compute budget toward the language model, not an oversized vision encoder, when building compact VLMs.",
                font_size=14, color=TEXT_PRIMARY)

    # Right-side stat box

def build_takeaways_slide(prs):
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    set_slide_bg(slide, DARK_BG)
    add_shape_bar(slide, Inches(0), Inches(0), SLIDE_WIDTH, Inches(0.06), ACCENT)

    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.7), Inches(0.45), Inches(12), Inches(0.8),
                "Key Takeaways: Design Principles for Efficient Multimodal Models",
                font_size=32, bold=True, color=WHITE)

    bullets = [
        "Balance encoder-LM compute: smaller vision encoders (93M SigLIP-B/16) outperform oversized ones for compact LMs.",
        "Extend context length deliberately: scaling RoPE base to 273K and mixing long/short data unlocks 16K context for high-resolution inputs.",
        "Use aggressive token compression for small models: pixel shuffle at r=4 yields 16× fewer tokens, easing attention and enabling long-context modeling.",
        "Sub-1GB inference is achievable: SmolVLM-256M uses 0.8 GB RAM and surpasses the 300× larger Idefics-80B — efficiency beats raw scale.",
        "Fully open-source release: all weights, datasets, code, and the HuggingSnap mobile app are public to accelerate on-device AI research."
    ]
    add_bullet_list(slide, Inches(0.7), Inches(1.5), Inches(12), Inches(5.0), bullets, font_size=18)

    # Bottom callout
    callout = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, Inches(0.7), Inches(6.0), Inches(12.0), Inches(0.9))
    callout.fill.solid(); callout.fill.fore_color.rgb = RgbColor(0x1E, 0x29, 0x3B)
    callout.line.color.rgb = ACCENT2; callout.line.width = Pt(2)
    ctf = callout.text_frame; ctf.word_wrap = True
    cp = ctf.paragraphs[0]; cp.text = "Implication for on-device AI: architectural efficiency — not parameter count — is the primary lever for deploying capable multimodal models at the edge."
    cp.font.size = Pt(15); cp.font.bold = True; cp.font.color.rgb = ACCENT2; cp.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = SLIDE_WIDTH
    prs.slide_height = SLIDE_HEIGHT

    build_title_slide(prs)
    build_problem_slide(prs)
    build_architecture_slide(prs)
    build_compute_allocation_slide(prs)
    build_token_compression_slide(prs)
    build_context_length_slide(prs)
    build_benchmark_slide(prs)
    build_on_device_slide(prs)
    build_takeaways_slide(prs)

    prs.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
    print(f"Saved presentation to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
